# Rankbox

> Rankbox is the AI search growth engine for founders — it researches your buyers' questions, writes daily source-backed articles, publishes to your site, and builds backlinks, engineered to get your brand cited by AI search engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity and ranked on Google.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rankbox.xyz/): What Rankbox does, how it works, proof, sample articles, pricing, and FAQ.
- [About](https://rankbox.xyz/about): Who makes Rankbox (Autusus LLC), when it started (2026, as Rankvolt), the editorial standards behind its guides, glossary and comparisons, and how to contact the company.
- [Changelog](https://rankbox.xyz/changelog): Every Rankbox release, dated, each marked live, rolling out or coming soon: Studio (several sites on one account), the connector library for 49 AI tools, the backlink exchange, Reddit Presence, and the Framer plugin. Also as RSS at /changelog/rss.xml.

## Solutions

- [AI search visibility](https://rankbox.xyz/solutions/ai-search-visibility): The four gates an AI engine checks before it names a brand (readable, answered, liftable, corroborated), an interactive demo of each, how an AI visibility tracker differs from Rankbox, and how to measure AI search visibility for free. Rankbox builds visibility (questions, articles, AI-readiness scoring, backlinks, Reddit reply drafts); it does not track AI citations yet.
- [AEO tools](https://rankbox.xyz/solutions/aeo-tools): 18 free answer engine optimization tools sorted by job, a live AI search readiness check, the AEO tool market by category with each vendor's dated starting price, and the Rankbox plan that runs three of the jobs on autopilot.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://rankbox.xyz/integrations): Every way to connect Rankbox: WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Framer and Square Online for publishing, the REST API, and 49 AI tools through the MCP server.
- [MCP server](https://rankbox.xyz/integrations/mcp): Add https://rankbox.xyz/mcp to any MCP client to get AI search questions, SEO content briefs, and meta descriptions.
- [Rankbox for Claude](https://rankbox.xyz/integrations/claude), [ChatGPT](https://rankbox.xyz/integrations/chatgpt), [Lovable](https://rankbox.xyz/integrations/lovable), [Cursor](https://rankbox.xyz/integrations/cursor), [Claude Code](https://rankbox.xyz/integrations/claude-code): Setup guides for connecting the MCP server, one page per AI tool.

## Free Tools

- [Free Tools](https://rankbox.xyz/tools): Free SEO and AI-search tools — no signup required.
- [Get Recommended by ChatGPT](https://rankbox.xyz/tools/get-recommended-by-chatgpt): Free tool that generates a personalized LinkedIn + About-Me plan so AI engines find and recommend you.

## AI SEO Guides

- [AI SEO guides](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo): How ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity — plus Copilot, Grok, Meta AI, DeepSeek, Le Chat and Manus — find and cite sources, compared side by side: indexes, crawlers, JavaScript rendering, referrers and the biggest lever for each.
- [ChatGPT SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/chatgpt): Technical guide to ChatGPT search — query fan-out and the August 2026 site: shift, OAI-SearchBot vs GPTBot vs ChatGPT-User, Bing and IndexNow, and tracking utm_source=chatgpt.com.
- [Google AI Overviews & AI Mode SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/google-ai-overviews): Eligibility (indexed, snippet-eligible, Search Console "Search generative AI" set to Include), query fan-out, snippet controls, and the Search Console generative AI report.
- [Gemini SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/gemini): How the Gemini app grounds answers in the Google Search index, what Google-Extended really blocks, and why the Search Console AI opt-out doesn't cover Gemini.
- [Claude SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/claude): Claude's web search runs on Brave Search; the ClaudeBot / Claude-SearchBot / Claude-User split; no JavaScript rendering; tracking claude.ai traffic.
- [Perplexity SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/perplexity): Perplexity's own 200B-URL index and passage reranking, PerplexityBot vs Perplexity-User, freshness filtering, and Comet Plus.
- [Microsoft Copilot SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/copilot): Copilot grounds answers in Bing's index; Bingbot, the noarchive and nocache tags, IndexNow, Bing Webmaster Tools' AI Performance report, and tracking Copilot traffic.
- [Grok SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/grok): How Grok searches the web and X, why xAI documents no crawler, what Grok cites, what Grokipedia does and doesn't do, and measuring Grok when referrers are stripped.
- [Meta AI SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/meta-ai): How Meta AI cites sources in WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and meta.ai; Meta-WebIndexer vs Meta-ExternalAgent, post search, and tracking Meta AI traffic.
- [DeepSeek SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/deepseek): How DeepSeek's Smart Search finds and cites pages: an undisclosed third-party search API, no documented crawler, and how to measure it.
- [Mistral Le Chat SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/mistral): How Le Chat (renamed Vibe in May 2026) cites pages from Brave Search results; the MistralAI-Index, MistralAI-User and MistralAI-Training bots.
- [Manus SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/ai-seo/manus): How the Manus agent researches in a cloud Chromium browser, the Manus-User agent and its Web Bot Auth signature, why robots.txt won't stop it, and tracking agent traffic.

## AI Search Glossary

- [AI search glossary](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary): SEO, GEO, AEO and LLM search terms, each defined in one sentence, then explained with sourced answers to real questions, an original framework or worked example, and related terms.
- [Generative engine optimization (GEO)](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/generative-engine-optimization): What GEO is, GEO vs SEO, where the term comes from (Aggarwal et al., KDD 2024), how to measure it, and the Four-Gate Citation Model.
- [Answer engine optimization (AEO)](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/answer-engine-optimization): Structuring content so answer engines use it as the answer itself.
- [LLM SEO](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/llm-seo): Visibility in what large language models say, from training data and from live search.
- [Query fan-out](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/query-fan-out): How AI engines split one question into many sub-searches, with the Fan-Out Coverage Map worked example.
- [Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/retrieval-augmented-generation): How AI engines retrieve sources before writing an answer.
- [AI crawlers](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/ai-crawlers): Training, search and user-triggered bots, and how to control each.
- [llms.txt](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/llms-txt): What the proposed standard is, and whether AI engines use it.
- [AI share of voice](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/ai-share-of-voice): How to measure how often AI answers cite you versus competitors.
- [Prompt tracking](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/prompt-tracking): Running a fixed panel of buyer prompts to see who AI engines cite.
- [AI referral traffic](https://rankbox.xyz/glossary/ai-referral-traffic): Identifying visits from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Copilot in analytics.
